She is one of five physicians in the Boston area offering this revolutionary procedure, solidifying her position as an authority in the field.  Dr. Shanthala was honored to share her clinical experience on Laser-Coring at prestigious conferences, including the Non-Surgical Symposium in Australia, Dubai Derma, and a leading IMCAS WORLD CONFERENCE in Paris in 2024.
